mechanism: Brimonidine is an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist that can potentiate CNS depression and anticholinergic effects when combined with tricyclic antidepressants like amitriptyline, which possess anticholinergic and CNS depressant properties.
action: Monitor patients for increased sedation, dizziness, and anticholinergic effects; use lowest effective dose of brimonidine and counsel on avoiding concurrent CNS depressants.
